beats.text: Imagine a demon creeps into your loneliest hour with a single question.
What if you had to live this life again — every joy, every pain, in the same order — forever?
Not a better life. Not a corrected one. This exact life, on endless repeat.
Nietzsche called it the eternal recurrence, and he meant it as a test.
Would you curse the demon and collapse? Or would you call it the greatest news you ever heard?
To answer yes, you must build a life you would choose to relive without end.
So live today as if you must live it, exactly like this, a thousand times over.

source_note: Idea from The Gay Science §341 (Common translation, public domain) — paraphrased.
